surface: exportable standalone scientific PNG/PDF figures, Matplotlib

accuracy.question: How does Ewald intensity error change with 3/5/9 q_z planes?
accuracy.variant: faceted box plots, mean diamonds, shared logarithmic percent scale
accuracy.grain: one method/model/orientation; 240 orientations per model; 4-pixel detector sampling
accuracy.palette: one blue root for complex projections, neutral existing baseline
accuracy.interpretation: Box whiskers are 5th/95th percentiles, dots include every remaining outlier.

cost.question: What synchronized end-to-end runtime and allocated GPU memory does each method need?
cost.variant: grouped bars for three geometries, zero-based axes
cost.grain: one method/model; three fresh-process timing batches of 48 orientations
cost.palette: blue/gold/olive with hatches for model identity
cost.uncertainty: Runtime bars show the median; whiskers show min/max of three batch averages.
cost.memory: Peak live CuPy allocation from a separate instrumented pass; excludes CUDA driver/context.
